exam_scheme.note: Selection is conducted in two phases: Phase 1 Computer Based Test (CBT) and Phase 2 Personal Interview, followed by Pre-Employment Medical Examination. The CBT consists of 85 objective MCQs (85 marks) for 90 minutes. For each incorrect response, 0.33 marks (1/3rd) are deducted. Sections comprise Domain Knowledge (50 MCQs, sectional qualifying mark: 20), General English (5 MCQs), Quantitative Aptitude (10 MCQs), Computer Proficiency in MS-Office (10 MCQs), and Test of Vernacular in Bengali/Nepali (10 MCQs, sectional qualifying mark: 4). Candidates are shortlisted for Personal Interview (15 marks) at Vidyut Bhavan, Kolkata in a 1:3 ratio based on normalized CBT merit.

financial_package.note: Pay scale for Junior Engineer (Electrical) Grade-II is fixed in Level 6 of the Pay Matrix under Revision of Pay and Allowances (ROPA-2020), WBSEDCL. Entry basic pay is ₹36,800 (pay band ₹36,800 to ₹1,06,700). In addition to basic pay, employees receive Dearness Allowance (at standard project constant 58% effective 1 Jul 2025), House Rent Allowance (12% of basic pay), Medical Benefits, and utility electricity concessions, resulting in an estimated gross remuneration of approx. ₹64,800/month.

competition_benchmarks.note: Official vacancies published directly by WBSEDCL in employment notifications. In the 2025 recruitment cycle (Notification No. MPP/2025/04 dated 24.11.2025), 401 vacancies were advertised for Junior Engineer (Electrical) Gr.-II across UR (100), UR-EC (52), UR-ExSM (12), SC (52), SC-EC (28), SC-ExSM (4), ST (16), ST-EC (9), OBC-A (28), OBC-A-EC (13), OBC-B (20), OBC-B-EC (8), UR-PwBD (14), SC-PwBD (4), EWS (25), EWS-EC (12), and EWS-ExSM (4). In the 2021 cycle (Notification No. MPP/2021/03), 414 total Junior Engineer vacancies were advertised (390 JE Electrical and 24 JE Civil).
